name: What factors influence the cost of installing a kitchen peninsula?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of installing a kitchen peninsula?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing a kitchen peninsula varies based on several factors, including its size, materials chosen for the countertop and cabinetry, and the complexity of integrating utilities like plumbing or electrical. Custom designs, high-end finishes, and extensive structural modifications for support or utility lines will increase the overall investment. Hometelligent provides detailed estimates after a site assessment to ensure all project specifics are accurately captured, giving you a clear understanding of the costs involved.
acceptedAnswer.description: Peninsula installation costs depend on size, materials, and utility integration. Custom designs and high-end finishes increase the investment.
